Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of V.
Operating income reached $9.2 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $18.4 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
We delivered record revenue of $18.4 billion this quarter, representing 19% year-over-year growth.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 574 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
